\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 297-298 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R301-first-pass-words-from-chapters-297-298}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a stapler and a ruler.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item refined white flour, flattened rice, a mushroom, a guava, an Indian gooseberry
  \item groceries, a packet, a salary, wages, a worker
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Refined white flour? (\textbf{\ml{മൈദ}}, \emph{maida}.) Flattened rice? (\textbf{\ml{അവൽ}}, \emph{aval}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{\ml{കൂൺ}}, \emph{kūṇ}.) A guava? (\textbf{\ml{പേരയ്ക്ക}}, \emph{pēraykka}.) An Indian gooseberry? (\textbf{\ml{നെല്ലിക്ക}}, \emph{nellikka}.) Groceries? (\textbf{\ml{പലചരക്ക്}}, \emph{palacarakkŭ}.) A packet? (\textbf{\ml{പാക്കറ്റ്}}, \emph{pākkaṟṟŭ}.) A salary? (\textbf{\ml{ശമ്പളം}}, \emph{śambaḷaṁ}.) Wages? (\textbf{\ml{കൂലി}}, \emph{kūli}.) A worker? (\textbf{\ml{തൊഴിലാളി}}, \emph{toḻilāḷi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 299-301 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R301-second-pass-words-from-chapters-299-301}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a factory and the government.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a factory, the government, a law, a college, a university
  \item an actor, a poet, weight, profit, a loss
  \item a contract, a tax, a fine, a stapler, a ruler
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A factory? (\textbf{\ml{ഫാക്ടറി}}, \emph{phākṭaṟi}.) The government? (\textbf{\ml{സർക്കാർ}}, \emph{sarkkār}.) A law? (\textbf{\ml{നിയമം}}, \emph{niyamaṁ}.) A college? (\textbf{\ml{കോളേജ്}}, \emph{kōḷējŭ}.) A university? (\textbf{\ml{സർവകലാശാല}}, \emph{sarvakalāśāla}.) An actor? (\textbf{\ml{നടൻ}}, \emph{naṭan}.) A poet? (\textbf{\ml{കവി}}, \emph{kavi}.) Weight? (\textbf{\ml{തൂക്കം}}, \emph{tūkkaṁ}.) Profit? (\textbf{\ml{ലാഭം}}, \emph{lābhaṁ}.) A loss? (\textbf{\ml{നഷ്ടം}}, \emph{naṣṭaṁ}.) A contract? (\textbf{\ml{കരാർ}}, \emph{karār}.) A tax? (\textbf{\ml{നികുതി}}, \emph{nikuti}.) A fine? (\textbf{\ml{പിഴ}}, \emph{piḻa}.) A stapler? (\textbf{\ml{സ്റ്റാപ്ലർ}}, \emph{sṟṟāplar}.) A ruler? (\textbf{\ml{സ്കെയിൽ}}, \emph{skeyil}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
